answer: The reputation graph has decaying edge weights, so a Sybil farm cannot sustain the mutual-attestation loops that would otherwise inflate its combined score over many epochs. This is why the honest majority can be small yet decisive: each vote carries the weight of verifiable work, not just the noise of a large flock.. The effect holds because jury selection is secret and random, so an attacker can never target the specific identities that will judge it. Consider a yarrow as the anchor of the cost.
